item.title: AIM movers: EDX Medical talking with more potential clients and Quantum Helium progress
item.summary: Diagnostics firm EDX Medical (LON: EDX) has raised £2.7m at 14p/share. The cash will fund the new employee health screening service. Discussions continue with three potential clients, and two more companies have approached EDX.
